method: No ground-truth vulnerabilities are known in these packages, so only precision is measured: every finding is triaged by hand as TP (a genuine instance of the weakness the rule names, reachable with data the program does not fix) or FP (the reported condition is false, or the data is constant/trusted by construction). All .js/.mjs/.cjs/.jsx files of each package are analysed (including dist/, test/ and benchmark files; nested node_modules excluded). Versions are pinned by package-lock.json; the benchmark flags any version drift.
